subject: Quick feedback on a 3D maxillofacial case review tool?
body:
Hi Dr. Brooks,

I'm Emmanuel, building MedViz, a browser-based 3D case review workflow for maxillofacial mesh review.

I reached out because you lead Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery at UTHSC, and I thought you might have a strong view on whether this kind of workflow is actually useful in practice.

The current version supports in-browser 3D review, measurements, annotations, slicing, orientation and unit confirmation, and exportable review reports.

If you're open to it, here is the live app: https://medviz-web-editor.vercel.app/

I'm looking for a few surgeons who can try it on a de-identified case or short demo and tell me what feels useful, confusing, or unnecessary.

Thanks,
Emmanuel
